sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Kapil Tyagi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The present bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in case crime No. 743 of 2023, under Sections-498A, 304B IPC and Sections-3 / 4 of D. P. Act, police station Sector 39 Noida, District Gautam Buddha Nagar, with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
3. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant-accused is innocent and he has not committed any offence.
Applicant is husband of the deceased.
The marriage of deceased with applicant has taken place on 6.6.2021.
Only general allegations of dowry demand and harassment of deceased have been levelled against all the accused persons, including the applicant.

The allegation that the deceased has suffered abortion for two times due to harassment meted out by Kaushal Kumar Jha vs State Of U.P. on 4 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/57768286/
1 the accused persons, is wholly false.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In fact the deceased has sufferened abortion for two times due to medical complications and due to that reason, she was under depression and committed suicide.
The dead body of deceased was taken out after breaking the door of the room.
In the post mortem report, except ligature mark, no other injury has been shown on the body of the deceased and the cause of death has been shown asphyxia due to ante mortem hanging.

4. It is further submitted that in their supplementary statements, the informant and other witnesses have not made any allegation of dowry demand or harassment of deceased and stated that they have lodged first information report in a fit of rage.
Further, during trial, the informant / PW 1 Hari Kant Mishra and PW 2 Smt. Mudrika Devi, who are father and mother of deceased, have not supported prosecution version and turned hostile.
They have denied prosecution version regarding harassment of deceased on account of dowry.

Lastly, it was submitted that the applicant is in jail since 27.10.2023 and there are number of formal witnesses, who are yet to be examined and thus, trial of the case would take sufficient long time.
It was stated that the applicant has no criminal history and that in case he is enlarged on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail.
5. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that the applicant is husband of deceased, who has suffered unnatural death within seven years of her marriage.

6. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the matter, a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

7. Let the applicant Kaushal Kumar Jha involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two local sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
i. The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during trial.
ii. The applicant will not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
iii. The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant will not try to contact, threat or otherwise influence the complainant or any of the witness of the case.
8. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of applicant, in accordance with law.
Order Date :- 4.6.2024 HR
